name: Hasnat Abdullah
role: Visible coordinator of Students Against Discrimination, student political organizer, and post-2024 youth political voice
contribution: He became a visible coordinator in the July 2024 quota reform and anti-discrimination movement, was taken into DB custody during the crackdown period, and remained active in post-2024 youth political organizing and reform discussions.
context: Students Against Discrimination, the July 2024 quota reform and student-citizen uprising, DB custody during the crackdown period, and post-2024 youth political organizing.
impact: His role is associated with student coordination, movement continuity under repression, and the emergence of youth-centered political organizing after 2024.
highlight: A visible student coordinator in the July 2024 movement who later remained active in youth political organizing.
